description: Keep dependency/test exclusions; package rules below exclude examples except the Slack bot's published image

packageRules.description: Unlike ignorePaths, matchFileNames supports negative patterns: keep other examples disabled while updating the released Slack bot image
In-repo Go modules resolve through go.work and replace directives; their published version floors and the Helm chart's own image tag are bumped deliberately by the release process
typescript-5.7 is a deliberate old-compiler alias for the SDK declaration compatibility check
Node and Deno versions in workflows are deliberate: SDK engine floors (Node 22, Deno 2.9.3) and exact publish-toolchain pins
stacklok/modelith is pinned past its latest tag (# post-v0.4.0), so it cannot be resolved; re-enable after repinning to a tagged release
Wait before adopting new npm releases (supply-chain hygiene)
Group routine images, CI actions, and toolchains; Go and JavaScript rules below override this fallback group
Group routine Go module updates across all modules
Group routine npm packages across JavaScript workspaces and CI, including pnpm pins so packageManager fields and action inputs move together
Keep approval-gated runner upgrades out of the routine batch so they cannot hold it up
Website: bump package.json ranges so every update is visible in the diff, not only in the lockfile
Website Node engine is pinned to a major (24.x) to match CI and Vercel; replace it on a new major instead of bumping

Studio runs one Node major everywhere, set by apps/package.json engines (>=26 <27); never propose the next major for the builder image, .node-version, or @types/node — move them together with engines on purpose
Studio runtime base tracks Chainguard latest by digest, which cannot be version-constrained; review it on its own so a Node major move is visible (the CI studio job rejects a major outside engines)
Label GitHub Actions and setup-tool updates without changing their dependency bucket
Keep pnpm major upgrades coordinated across packageManager fields and pnpm/action-setup inputs; routine pnpm updates join the shared batch
